description: Search Germany's official federal statistics (Destatis GENESIS) for data tables by keyword — population, GDP, inflation/CPI, employment, foreign trade, production, etc. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for German official statistics. Returns matching table codes (e.g. "12411-0001") + titles; pass a code to destatis_table to get the data.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own free Destatis GENESIS API token. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx token.

name: destatis_search
title: Destatis Search
